g.text: SCR06 — Call logs
Kotlin Compose screen definition · Per-client logging / FR-KT-02 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR06.C01 · Inspect record
Fields: Principal/rule/schema pins, timing and sanitized error; no secrets
Open redacted bounded call record and observed/unknown outcome
Failure: Missing optional payload says not logged, never reconstructs it
SCR06.C02 · Export selected scope
Fields: Selected clients/time/outcome, bytes and redaction policy
Prepare exact redacted export snapshot then SCR09 approve snapshot ID/hash/scope
Failure: Auth/quota failure creates no document; a changed selection needs new approval
SCR06.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR06.C04 · Filter logs
Fields: Client/time/outcome, page limit and pinned cursor
Filter bounded redacted records within owner scope
Failure: Expired cursor restarts read, not replay of historical calls
SCR06.C05 · Choose export document
Fields: Approved snapshot ID/hash and user-selected destination
Write the approved sealed export through Android create-document
Failure: Picker cancel/partial I/O releases snapshot and reports written/unknown bytes; no automatic retry
SCR06.C06 · Edit retention quotas
Fields: Exact client_id and client_logging_config.logging_revision; mode/paused/retention/byte quota; global audit reserve is a read-only ceiling in
this editor
Open the same per-client logging editor; draft then exact SCR09 CAS save for this client only
Failure: Invalid/low capacity rejects; mandatory audit failure closes new dispatch
SCR06.C07 · Cancel export
Fields: Current export state and destination grant
Cancel export and release unconsumed sealed snapshot
Failure: Already-written document is not silently deleted; partial write is explicit
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR06.S0 · Redacted log page
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Selected record is historical observed/unknown outcome, never a runnable action.
Recovery: Filter/read or prepare an exact scoped export.
SCR06.S1 · No matching logged calls
Disabled: SCR06.C01, SCR06.C02, SCR06.C05, SCR06.C07
Effect: No record selected; disabled payload logging is shown explicitly.
Recovery: Change filters or return after new admitted calls; do not fabricate records.
SCR06.S2 · Export approval missing/denied
Disabled: SCR06.C05
Effect: No document or sealed authorized export is released.
Recovery: Request a new exact scoped SCR09 approval or cancel.
SCR06.S3 · Audit reserve/quota failure
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Mandatory durable audit capacity exhausted; new dispatch fail-closed, optional logs evict first.
Recovery: Review retention under owner auth; inspect write error before retrying safe startup.
SCR06.S4 · Approved export: create-document picker
Disabled: SCR06.C02, SCR06.C04, SCR06.C06
Effect: Pinned redacted snapshot approved; only this selection may be written.
Recovery: Choose destination or Cancel; selection change discards approval and needs new review.
SCR06.S5 · Export partial/unknown write
Disabled: SCR06.C02, SCR06.C05
Effect: Destination may contain a partial document; no automatic rewrite or deletion.
Recovery: Show bytes/hash when known; owner inspects/discards destination before any new export.
